context: Demonstration of train/test leakage due to overlapping sliding windows on the same capture vs honest capture-level splitting.

methodology.random_window_split: Shuffling and splitting all window snapshots randomly. Windows covering the same physical packet flow but shifted by 1 second leak exact features.
methodology.capture_level_split: Splitting strictly by independent captures (PCAP files). Windows from one PCAP are only in Train, or only in Test.

random_window_split.conclusion: Invalid / Fabricated performance due to data leakage.

capture_level_split.conclusion: Honest baseline performance reflecting real-world generalization.

remediation: All future dataset splitting must strictly adhere to capture-level boundaries. Random row-wise splits are strictly forbidden for windowed data.
